name: Nili Patera
coordinate_source: 8.9N, 67.2E project reference from existing TI/albedo sources; transformed using Mars sphere

regional.quality_note: MOLA bins may contain interpolated elevations where no laser shot existed; this is not 30m DEM data.

detailed.quality_note: MOLA bins may contain interpolated elevations where no laser shot existed; this is not 30m DEM data.

methods.steep_fraction: fraction of slope samples greater than 15 degrees
methods.relief: elevation percentile 95 minus percentile 5, in metres
methods.roughness_m: SD of elevation minus weighted Gaussian-smoothed elevation; sigma=1000m, matching mars_prep.py
methods.resampling: NONE: native MOLA 128 pixels/degree, pixel centres inside a projected 10km/5km square
methods.nodata: NASA PDS MOLA gridded topography; some source bins are interpolated when shot coverage is absent
methods.native_source_grid: Planetocentric 0E-90E, 44N-0N, 128 pixels/degree, MSB signed int16 topography metres
methods.resolution_limit: Both regional and detailed computed at native ~460m. NO 30m detail exists in this source.
